chunks: The gathering of Abū Manṣūr ibn al-Marzubān, and in the gathering there was a group of the theologians of the Muʿtazilah.

key_terms.أَبِي: of Abū, part of the proper name and lineage reference
key_terms.الْمَرْزُبَانِ: al-Marzubān, the family name of the person mentioned
key_terms.جَمَاعَةٌ: a group or assembly of people

ai.seo_question: What does this report say about the gathering of Abū Manṣūr ibn al-Marzubān?
ai.summary: This passage briefly describes a gathering belonging to Abū Manṣūr ibn al-Marzubān. It notes the presence of a group of Muʿtazilī theologians, indicating an intellectual and theological setting.
